hardQuoteObservations.preregisteredQuote: Monjyayaki, Izakaya (Japanese style tavern), Okonomiyaki (Japanese savory pancake)
[2-Hour All You Can Drink] "Shio" - Seafood Delight Course -

This is a must-try course for seafood lovers, featuring select seafood sourced daily from a long-standing wholesale shop at Toyosu Market. We proudly serve the highest quality mentaiko (spicy cod roe) available in the country, along with our signature monja named after Koboreya. Additionally, indulge in our okonomiyaki, featuring a fluffy batter filled generously with scallops from Nagamanbe, and our exceptional yakisoba flavored with a special soy sauce, perfectly complemented by scallops, squid, clams, and pork belly.
[2-Hour All You Can Drink] "Kizuna" - Special Course for 2 People -

This is the Tsukishima classic course exclusively for couples. We will serve a combination of Koboreya's signature dishes and course-exclusive items. Enjoy the simple yet delightful flavors of our premium ingredients, including the tempura from Michelin Bib Gourmand-rated Tempura Abe, and a dashi broth made from Kyoto's long-established Fukushima Katsuo and pork back bones.
[2-Hour All You Can Drink] "Tsuki" - Tsukishima Enjoyment Course -

For those experiencing Tsukishima Monja for the first time, we highly recommend the "Koboreya" special course. Indulge in the classic Tsukishima-style Mentaiko Monja, featuring a rich sauce flavor with pork and Baby Star snacks, beloved since the Showa era. This dish uses the highest quality Mentaiko available in Japan. Additionally, enjoy our special soy sauce yakisoba made with chewy noodles, and a fluffy, carefully crafted Okonomiyaki.
